name: GCC, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: GCC, S.A.B. de C.V., through its subsidiaries, produces, markets, and distributes cement, aggregates, ready-mix concrete, and other materials for the construction industry in Mexico and the United States. The company offers cement, ready mix concrete, building materials, and asphalt, as well as energy. It also provides specialty products, including Komponent, a shrinkage-compensating expanding concrete additive; Microsilex for use in bridge decks and paving; Rapid Set, a solution for concrete applications; and Versabind, a cementitious that is used as filler in asphalt mixes as a replacement for lime.
